steps.target: Preview setup dialog after Preview action (doc step)

steps.value: Depending on the scenario of your entry's publish status you will see different modals (doc): Environment/Locale, Scheduled Publish, Release, and/or tentative Date and Time as described below.

Unpublished Entries (doc): If the entry is not published in any environment and not scheduled, select Environment and Locale to preview. If not added to any release and not scheduled for publishing, input a tentative Date and Time to proceed.
Scheduled Publishing (doc): For scheduled publishes, select Environment and Locale; use the Scheduled Publish dropdown when the entry is scheduled for publishing.

Added to an Undeployed Release (doc): Select Environment and Locale; if part of a release but not deployed, input a tentative Date and Time. From Releases, previewing an undeployed release may prompt for tentative Date and Time.
Added to a Deployed Release (doc): Select Environment and Locale; if already deployed via a release, use the Release dropdown to select the release.
